proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Walked in on a Saturday afternoon, picked a swallow off the flash wall and was done before sunset. The sheet had the price on it, and that's exactly what I paid.
reviews.name: Danny R.

reviews.text: They told me straight: no ocean for two weeks and keep it out of the sun. Living in Seal Beach that hurt, but my ship healed bright and solid.
reviews.name: Kalani M.

reviews.text: Old tribal armband from my twenties, covered with a koi in two sittings. Marisela drew right over a photo of the band so I could see how the dark parts would hide.
reviews.name: Rudy V.

reviews.text: My husband and I picked matching anchors off the wall for our tenth anniversary. About an hour each, and both healed clean and still bold.
reviews.name: Brenda T.

reviews.text: Nostril and conch for my birthday. They marked both, showed me in the mirror, and named the titanium they used. Healed with zero drama.
reviews.name: Yesenia P.

reviews.text: Brought in a rose from another shop that had gone patchy after a few summers. They redid the lines and packed the red again. It looks like it did the first week.
reviews.name: Hector G.

proof.guarantee: Any flash or custom piece gets one touch-up on us within 4 months.
